purpose: Define the complete reference-quality acceptance contract for Nocturne and its composed quirks without fabricating absent runtime behavior.
governing_principles: Each quirk must perform bounded useful behavior independently.
Nocturne must compose quirks through declared contracts rather than opaque sequential invocation.
Authority remains with each authoritative source definition.
Nocturne may attach to Opus but may not assume Opus provider-orchestration authority.
Network access must be denied unless explicitly authorized for an execution.
All external observations remain evidence or proposals until accepted by authority.
Nocturne must expose complete lineage, provenance, dependencies, relationships, failures, metrics, and future apertures.
Absent implementation must be reported as absent rather than represented as complete.

quality_gates.description: Nocturne and all four quirks validate against the shared identity quality schema.
Every definition exposes one active authority source and complete succession history.
Composition lineage is cycle-free and reconstructible from authoritative relationships.
Every definition and runtime result exposes source paths, hashes, transformations, and execution provenance.
All quirk inputs, outputs, errors, and cross-quirk exchanges use versioned contracts.
Veil, Lantern, Scribe, and Echo each expose useful independently testable behavior.
Nocturne fuses quirk outputs through declared routing, weighting, correlation, and validation behavior.
Filesystem, subprocess, network, provider, and secret access are denied unless explicitly authorized and audited.
Every invocation emits structured events, metrics, health state, and traceable failure evidence.
Unit, property, contract, integration, security, performance, parity, and recovery tests pass.
The Opus attachment is explicit, reversible, contract-governed, and authority-preserving.
Indexes, reports, observatory views, documentation, and runtime bundles are deterministic disposable projections.

quirk.nocturne.veil.purpose: Apply authorized routing and operational-security transformations to a declared transport plan without claiming anonymity or security beyond observed evidence.

quirk.nocturne.lantern.purpose: Discover, normalize, index, and map explicitly authorized network-location observations while preserving exact provenance and uncertainty.

quirk.nocturne.scribe.purpose: Parse authorized source material into structured observations with exact source-span provenance and explicit uncertainty.

quirk.nocturne.echo.purpose: Correlate authorized observations across sources, detect supported patterns, and emit bounded threat hypotheses without promoting inference to authority.

rules: No stage may discard source provenance.
No inference may be represented as accepted authority.
No unavailable quirk may be silently substituted.
Partial results must expose omitted or failed stages.
Equal inputs, policies, versions, and observations must produce equal deterministic projections.
External side effects require explicit execution authority.

unit: each quirk validates its own inputs
each quirk fails closed on unavailable dependencies
integration: partial composition remains valid when optional quirks are unavailable
security: network access is denied without authority
filesystem writes are denied unless declared
subprocess execution is denied unless declared
secret material is never emitted in reports
performance: correlation work respects configured resource limits
recovery: replay uses recorded policies and versions

apertures.admission: Requires versioned contracts, explicit authority, security review, tests, lineage, and provenance.

apertures.purpose: Admit compatible source parsers and extraction providers.
apertures.admission: Requires deterministic extraction behavior and exact source-span provenance.

apertures.purpose: Admit compatible correlation and analysis providers.
apertures.admission: Requires bounded inference, confidence reporting, validation, and authority isolation.

apertures.purpose: Admit read-only projections for runtime, lineage, provenance, security, and result inspection.
apertures.admission: Projection must not own copied authority.
